style: Photorealistic, real-world footage shot on a cinema camera with a macro lens. One continuous shot, no cuts. Constant, clearly visible motion for the whole clip. Low-key look: near-black shadows, rich deep greens and a few bright emerald highlights, strong contrast, crisp detail, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, no hands.

framing.l: Keep the left half of the frame darker and calm, as space for text. The brightest detail sits right of center.
framing.p: Keep the bottom half of the frame darker and calm, as space for text. The brightest detail sits in the upper half.

themes.name: Mycelium network
themes.prompt: Time-lapse macro of real white-green fungal mycelium spreading across dark wet forest soil: fine threads branch, grow toward each other and fuse into a glowing web that links small plant roots. The camera pushes in slowly.

themes.name: Fern unfurling
themes.prompt: Time-lapse of a real fern fiddlehead slowly unrolling into a bright green frond in a dark forest, beads of dew catching a soft green light, other young fronds unfurling behind it. The camera drifts slowly upward.

themes.name: Roots over basalt
themes.prompt: Time-lapse macro of real pale-green plant roots and moss creeping across black volcanic basalt, the root tips branching and joining into a connected network, wet stone glistening. The camera glides slowly sideways.

themes.name: Glowing fungi
themes.prompt: Night macro of real bioluminescent mushrooms glowing soft green on a mossy fallen log in a dark forest, faint green threads of light running through the moss between them, tiny spores drifting in the air. The camera pushes in slowly.
